About the Team
The Personalization-Memory team, within OpenAI's broader Personal AGI organization, is focused on developing agents that can learn from prior interactions in order to become more helpful and efficient over time. We build general-purpose memory and personalization capabilities that transfer across ChatGPT and other agentic products, and we collaborate with applied engineering on the product surfaces that allow users to interact with memory.

About the Role
As a Research Engineer / Research Scientist on the Personalization-Memory team, you will research and develop improvements to memory usage and personalization in OpenAI's frontier models. Our team works on reinforcement learning, dataset creation, evaluations, and other post-training methods. We partner closely with research and product teams across the company to realize the vision of a truly personalized ChatGPT.
We're looking for individuals who have a background in frontier model post-training, are able to iterate quickly, and who are passionate about product-driven research.
This role is based in San Francisco, CA. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees.

In this role, you will:
• Own and pursue a research agenda for improving memory use and personalization in frontier models.

• Build robust evaluations for tracking modeling improvements.

• Design, implement, test, and debug code across our research stack.

• Collaborate closely with the research and product teams to influence the shape of technical solutions in the product.

You might thrive in this role if you:
• Are passionate about personalization and building personalized assistants.

• Have experience working with user signals and human data to turn feedback into reliable signals for training and evaluation.

• Have a deep understanding of frontier model post-training and machine learning applications.

• Value principled approaches and research craftsmanship.

• Are comfortable diving into a large ML codebase to debug.

• Thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic, and technically complex environment.

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. jobs.description:
Who are we?
Cohere is the leading security-first enterprise AI company. We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems.
We’re training and deploying frontier models for enterprises who are building AI systems. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI and we are looking for folks that want to be part of that.
We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are all passionate about their craft.
We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us!

Key Overview:
As a Member of Technical Staff in Post-Training, you will train our large language models (LLMs) with reinforcement learning and develop methods that help them generalize beyond the distribution they were trained on. You will design the training recipes, environments, and evaluations that tell us whether a model has truly learned a skill or has only fitted its training tasks, and turn what works into the recipes behind our production models. You will work closely with the post-training data infrastructure, evaluation, and pre-training teams.

Key Responsibilities
• Design, run, and analyse large-scale RL post-training experiments (e.g., RLHF, RL from verifiable rewards).

• Research and develop methods that improve out-of-distribution generalization, such as reward design, environment and task diversity, curricula, and regularization.

• Build held-out evaluations that measure generalization to unseen tasks, domains, and formats, and that catch reward hacking and benchmark overfitting.

• Diagnose training dynamics and failure modes, including instability, reward over-optimization, and capability regressions.

• Turn successful research into robust, reproducible training recipes for production models.

Qualifications
• Strong research and software engineering skills, with hands-on experience training LLMs.

• Experience applying reinforcement learning to LLMs (e.g., PPO, GRPO, RLHF, RLVR), ideally at scale.

• Track record of work on generalization, robustness, or distribution shift, through publications or shipped models.

• Rigorous experimental practice: clean ablations, careful controls, and sound conclusions from noisy results.

• Experience with distributed training (e.g., JAX, PyTorch, FSDP, Megatron) is a plus.

• Excellent communication skills.

• Deep understanding of data quality principles and best practices: demonstrates willingness to dive deep into data while possessing strong intuition for assessing the quality of datasets and anticipating how different data characteristics will impact model training outcomes.

Working Location
This role can be based remotely or from one of our office locations listed on the job description - there is no minimum in-office qualification requirement. We care most about hiring exceptional people regardless of locations, though please check the location listed on the posting for guidance around the core time zone or working hours alignment expected for the role.

Full-Time Employees at Cohere enjoy these Perks:
• A weekly lunch stipend of $75/£75 or equivalent in your local currency for lunch.

• Full health and dental benefits, including a separate budget for mental health.

• RRSP matching, 401K, Pension Scheme.

• 100% Parental Leave top-up for up to 6 months, for either parent.

• Annual enrichment benefits:
Arts & culture, fitness/wellness, quality time, and a workspace improvement credit.
Education & learning stipend for conferences, courses, and coaching.

• 6 weeks of paid vacation (30 working days!)

• Budget for traveling to other offices if you are remote, plus an annual company offsite.

How and Where We Work:
• Cohere is remote-friendly, but we also have offices in Toronto, London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul with more opening soon.

• For those in the office: a daily lunch program, plenty of snacks, and regular community and social events.

• For those not near an office: a co-working benefit so you can work alongside others in your city.

• Everyone receives a $500 home office stipend to set up your workspace properly.

If any of the above doesn’t line up exactly with your experience, we still encourage you to apply.

We strive to create an inclusive work environment for all; we welcome applicants from all backgrounds and are committed to providing equal opportunities. Should you require any accommodations during the recruitment process, please submit an Accommodations Request Form , and we will work together to meet your needs.

We may use AI-enabled tools to screen and assess applicants against the criteria for this position. This helps our recruiters identify potentially qualified candidates, but it doesn't limit the applications our recruiters may review or consider.

Beware of Scams: Cohere will never ask for payment or third-party services (e.g., CV writing) as part of our hiring process. All legitimate roles are listed on the Cohere careers page and LinkedIn only, with all communications from Cohere employees coming from an @cohere.com or @cw.cohere email alias. If jobs are viewed on other sites then please verify these through our official careers page.

jobs.description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

Anthropic is bringing Claude to the U.S. government and allied democracies, and we’re looking for startup-minded engineers to grow our public sector engineering team. This is a small team with large surface area. You’ll work across the stack to take products from 0 to 1 and beyond.

We are looking for product- and civic-minded engineers with a track record of building and scaling great products. The opportunities outpace our ability to build them all, so the right candidate thrives on sharp judgment, prioritization, and focus. You’ll own work like:

• Building Claude products that can be used by customers in highly regulated environments

• Deploying Claude into government networks

• Understanding and improving Claude’s usefulness in common government workflows – for example, policy research, benefits administration, intelligence analysis

• Scaling and innovating Claude for Government, our existing product serving U.S. government customers today

Our team is filling a number of roles and is open to candidates with either full-stack or backend experience.

Key responsibilities

• Architect and ship deployments that meet public sector compliance and security requirements, from FedRAMP to classified networks

• Build AI applications tailored to government workflows by developing deep understanding of how agencies actually operate

• Partner with research and safeguards teams to evaluate and improve Claude for government use cases

• Work directly with government customers and internal go-to-market teams to turn requirements into technical and product roadmaps

• Design scalable systems for deployment, user management, and administrative controls across constrained environments

• Create clarity and technical direction in a fast-moving environment with unique constraints

Minimum qualifications

• Experience building AI products and a working intuition for their capabilities and limitations

• A strong technical track record building and shipping enterprise- or government-grade products

• Excellent cross-functional collaboration skills — you’ll partner with sales, legal, research, and policy teams alike

Preferred qualifications

• Have 8+ years of experience as a full stack or backend software engineer

• Startup experience, particularly in scaling products from zero to one

• Experience partnering with sales, customer success, and professional services teams to drive product adoption

• Experience deploying software on government networks

• Active federal security clearance (Secret or above)

This position requires verification of U.S. citizenship due to citizenship-based legal restrictions. Specifically, this position supports a United States federal, state, and/or local government agency customer and is subject to certain citizenship-based restrictions where required or permitted by applicable law. To meet this legal requirement, citizenship will be verified via a valid passport, or other approved documents, or verified US government clearance.
The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary:
$405,000 — $485,000 USD

Logistics

Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How we're different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

jobs.description:
Reddit is a community of communities. It’s built on shared interests, passion, and trust, and is home to the most open and authentic conversations on the internet. Every day, Reddit users submit, vote, and comment on the topics they care most about. With 100,000+ active communities and approximately 130 million daily active unique visitors, Reddit is one of the internet’s largest sources of information. For more information, visit www.redditinc.com .

The opportunity

Build the machine learning capabilities that help advertisers understand what they could achieve on Reddit and make better investment decisions.

On the Forecasting team, you will develop models that estimate how campaign outcomes could change with different budgets, bids, audiences, creative performance, or objectives. Your work will connect supply and demand forecasting, audience availability, and response prediction to help advertisers compare alternatives and identify valuable opportunities.

This is a hands-on role with end-to-end ownership of forecasting models and production capabilities. You will drive projects from problem formulation and technical design through evaluation, deployment, and iteration, working closely with engineers and cross-functional partners.

What you’ll do

• Own forecasting and scenario modeling projects. Translate advertiser questions into modeling problems involving delivery, reach, performance, and investment tradeoffs. Develop technical approaches, make practical tradeoffs, and drive execution.

• Connect inventory, demand, and response. Use signals about available advertising opportunities, audience activity, marketplace competition, and predicted response to improve estimates of achievable campaign outcomes.

• Model outcomes under alternative choices. Build and improve models that estimate the effects of changes in budget, bid, audience, or optimization objective, accounting for relevant auction dynamics and campaign constraints.

• Help advertisers identify opportunity. Incorporate predictions from partner teams, including creative-performance estimates, to evaluate potential improvements in delivery, efficiency, or advertiser value.

• Improve model generalization. Develop approaches for sparse segments, cold start, seasonality, delayed feedback, and changing marketplace conditions. Choose methods that balance predictive quality, complexity, and production requirements.

• Build trustworthy evaluations. Measure forecast accuracy, calibration, uncertainty, and performance across advertiser cohorts. Document modeling assumptions and limitations, and work with partners to determine which scenario comparisons the evidence supports.

• Close the learning loop. Compare predictions with mature outcomes, investigate systematic errors, and use experiments and observed results to improve forecasts and validate scenario estimates.

• Deliver reliable production systems. Own training, inference, monitoring, and iteration for your models. Collaborate with Product, Data Science, Ads Delivery, Audience, and Creative teams; contribute to design and code reviews; and mentor engineers through project work.

What we’re looking for

• Experience independently designing, shipping, and improving predictive ML systems in advertising, marketplaces, recommendations, search, forecasting, or similarly complex domains.

• Strong foundations in statistical learning, probability, and optimization, with experience working with large-scale behavioral or transactional data.

• Practical experience in at least one relevant area, such as forecasting, response prediction, probabilistic modeling, multitask learning, or transfer learning.

• Sound evaluation judgment, including temporal validation, segment-level analysis, and an understanding of calibration, uncertainty, and the limits of predictions under changed conditions.

• Experience diagnosing and addressing modeling challenges such as sparse observations, cold start, seasonality, distribution shift, selection bias, or delayed labels.

• Strong programming and software engineering skills, including experience building and operating production ML pipelines and services.

• Demonstrated ability to turn ambiguous product questions into concrete technical plans, lead projects through rollout, and collaborate effectively across functions.

Preferred experience

Experience in one or more of:

• Demand, supply, and inventory forecasting: Advertising inventory, marketplace demand, traffic, retail demand, or capacity forecasting, including time-series methods, hierarchical or global models, and multi-horizon prediction.

• Auction and investment modeling: Auction simulation or replay, win-rate and price prediction, bid/budget response curves, or constrained optimization.

• Scenario evaluation: Counterfactual or off-policy evaluation, sensitivity analysis, uncertainty propagation, or combining predictive models to estimate campaign outcomes.

• Reach and audience estimation: Population and overlap estimation, reach/frequency models, sampling correction, or saturation modeling.

• Probabilistic and response modeling: Quantile or distributional prediction, calibrated conversion/value prediction, or delayed-feedback modeling.

What success looks like

You independently deliver and operate forecasting capabilities that improve accuracy and calibration for priority advertiser populations. Your models support credible comparisons of campaign alternatives, have clear evaluation and monitoring, and help advertisers make better planning and investment decisions.

Benefits:

• Comprehensive Healthcare Benefits and Income Replacement Programs

• 401k with Employer Match

• Global Benefit programs that fit your lifestyle, from workspace to professional development to caregiving support

• Family Planning Support

• Gender-Affirming Care

• Mental Health & Coaching Benefits

Who We Are
Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together . We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.

Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.

About the Role
Notion is building the operating system for knowledge work, and we want people to be able to do substantive knowledge work from their phone .
A great native app is what makes that possible. On Android, that means Notion should feel like it was built for the platform: fast to open, smooth to scroll, and reliable offline or on a spotty connection. We’re investing in a more native foundation for how people read, write, and edit in Notion. That lets users capture ideas in the moment, find answers across their workspace, manage tasks and projects, and work with teammates, with the speed, polish, and dependability people expect from the best apps on their phone.
As an Android engineer, you’ll help build that native foundation, from how pages render and how people write and edit, to the navigation and app chrome people use every day, like Home, Search, and Inbox, along with the shared frameworks the rest of the app is built on. You’ll work across the Android stack, with chances to dig into our shared Rust layer and the AI tools we use for mobile development. Along the way, you’ll pair with experienced product and mobile AI engineers to find what slows the team down, try new Android capabilities, and help decide what ships in the app.
This role can be based in either San Francisco or New York City. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days.

What You'll Achieve
• Ship the core Notion experience on Android: Build and polish the surfaces people use every day—opening and reading pages, writing and editing, navigating the app, and the Home, Search, and Inbox tabs—on a native Kotlin and Jetpack Compose stack that is fast to open, smooth to scroll, and dependable offline.

• Build with product and design, and iterate fast: Partner with product managers and designers to turn ideas into shipped features, then use feedback and data to make them better. Use AI coding tools and agents to build, test, and investigate faster, while you stay accountable for review, validation, and quality.

• By the end of your first year, own a core product area: Take a core part of the Android app, like Home, Inbox, or a piece of the editor, from idea to launch, and shape it into an experience that helps people do their life’s work from their phone.

• Make the app feel fast and reliable: Find and fix issues in startup time, scrolling, typing latency, crashes, and memory use across the surfaces you own, and add the tests and monitoring that catch regressions before users do.

Skills You'll Need to Bring
• Solid Android fundamentals: You’ve built and shipped Android apps, through work, internships, or your own projects, and you’re comfortable with modern Android—Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, Coroutines/Flow, and Gradle. Experience with a large, modular codebase is a plus.

• Care for native UI and performance: You enjoy making UI feel fast and smooth, and you’re curious about things like custom text rendering, complex lazy lists, or rich-text editing. Experience with performance profiling, realtime collaboration, or offline sync is a plus.

• Product instincts: You care about how the app feels to use, not just how it works. You sweat the details of interactions and polish, and you use feedback and data to decide what to build next.

• Thoughtful problem-solving and clear communication: You build a clear picture of the problem before jumping to a fix, you can explain trade-offs in writing, and you ask for help early when you’re stuck. Experience moving a hybrid or web-based surface to native, or building something from 0→1, is a plus.

• AI-native, end-to-end engineering practice: You use AI tools and agents as real collaborators, framing tasks clearly, reviewing generated changes, testing behavior, and designing workflows that make the broader team more effective. Web experience (TypeScript, React, Node) is welcome but not required.

For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. jobs.description:
Zscaler (NASDAQ: ZS) accelerates digital transformation so customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. The Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange platform protects thousands of customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location. Distributed across 200+ public data centers globally and thousands of private sites at the edge, the SASE-based Zero Trust Exchange is the world’s largest in-line cloud security platform.

We believe the future of work is Human + AI and are building an AI-native enterprise where human potential is amplified by machine intelligence to solve the world’s hardest security challenges. Driven by deep customer obsession, we are committed to the mission, outcome, and to each other. We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler.

Role

We are looking for a Staff Software Engineer - AI Security to join our team. This is a Hybrid role based in San Jose, CA, reporting to the Director, Software Engineering in the Engineering department. We are building security products that enable organizations to adopt AI applications and agents safely and at scale. As a Staff Software Engineer, you will take ownership of complex engineering challenges, build secure and scalable systems, and raise the technical bar through hands-on execution and collaboration.

What you’ll do (Role Expectations)

• Define technical direction and architecture for major areas of the product

• Lead high-impact initiatives that span multiple teams and system boundaries

• Turn ambiguous product and security challenges into clear, executable engineering strategies

• Establish standards for secure, reliable, scalable, and maintainable systems

• Identify systemic risks, architectural gaps, and investments needed for long-term growth

Who You Are (Success Profile)

• You thrive in ambiguity. You build the path as you walk it, viewing ambiguity not as a hindrance but as raw material to create impactful solutions.

• You act like an owner. Your passion for the mission fuels your bias for action, seamlessly navigating between high-level strategy and hands-on execution.

• You are a problem-solver. You are energized by complex challenges and finding elegant solutions that deliver maximum value.

• You are a high-trust collaborator. You build strong relationships through clear feedback, respect, and a commitment to team success.

• You are driven by innovation. You possess a deep curiosity for how systems work and are energized by solving technical challenges at the cutting edge of AI security.

What We’re Looking for (Minimum Qualifications)

• Demonstrated curiosity and active exploration of AI tools, with a proven history of integrating new technologies to enhance daily workflows and augment problem-solving

• 5+ years of software-engineering experience, including technical leadership across complex production systems

• Strong proficiency in Go, Rust, and Python, with deep expertise in systems engineering, security engineering, and backend platforms

• Demonstrated experience architecting and evolving platforms that span multiple teams or product areas

• Proven ability to remain hands-on through coding, prototyping, design review, and complex debugging

• Deep understanding of concurrency, networking, storage, APIs, data systems, and cloud infrastructure on AWS, GCP, or Azure

What Will Make You Stand Out (Preferred Qualifications)

• Experience building enterprise security, endpoint, cloud, or infrastructure products

• Familiarity with AI/ML systems, analytics platforms, AI applications, or AI security

• Experience helping a startup or high-growth product evolve into a scalable engineering organization
